params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch correctly addresses the SonarQube warning by extracting duplicated string literals and related constant values into static final constants. All occurrences of these literals in the test methods are replaced with references to these constants, which reduces duplication and centralizes the values for easier maintenance. There are no unrelated or unnecessary changes; the modifications are focused solely on fixing the duplication issue. Minor formatting and comment changes are acceptable and do not affect functionality.
